sourceTexts.hebrew: וַיֹּ֣אֲמַר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּתֹ֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם׃
sourceTexts.aramaic: וַאֲמַר יְיָ יְהֵי רְקִיעָא בְּגוֹ מַיָּא וִיהֵי מַפְרֵישׁ בֵּין מַיָּא לְמַיָּא
sourceTexts.greek: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός γενηθήτω στερέωμα ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ ἔστω διαχωρίζον ἀνὰ μέσον ὕδατος καὶ ὕδατος
sourceTexts.latin: Dixit quoque Deus fiat firmamentum in medio aquarum et dividat aquas ab aquis
sourceTexts.geez: ወይቤ እግዚአብሔር ለይኩን ጠፈር ማእከለ ማይ ወለይፍለጥ ማእከለ ማይ ወማይ
sourceTexts.syriac: ܘܐܡܪ ܐܠܗܐ ܢܗܘܐ ܪܩܝܥܐ ܡܨܥܬ ܡܝܐ ܘܢܗܘܐ ܦܪܫ ܒܝܬ ܡܝܐ ܠܡܝܐ
sourceTexts.coptic: peje phnuti je mare ou-stereōma šōpe hn t-mēte n-n-moou n-f-pōrj n-t-mēte n-n-moou mn n-moou
sourceTexts.armenian: Եւ ասաց Աստուած. Եղիցի հաստատութիւն ի մէջ ջուրցն, եւ եղիցի մեկնել ի մէջ ջրոյ եւ ջրոյ։

literalTranslations.pt: E disse Deus: Haja um firmamento no meio das águas, e separe as águas das águas.
literalTranslations.en: And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E disse o Senhor: Haja um firmamento no meio das águas, e separe as águas das águas.
literalTranslations.en: And the Lord said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters.

literalTranslations.pt: E disse Deus: Seja feito um firmamento no meio da água, e que ele divida entre água e água.
literalTranslations.en: And God said, Let a firmament come to be in the midst of the water, and let it divide between water and water.

literalTranslations.pt: Disse também Deus: Faça-se o firmamento no meio das águas e divida as águas das águas.
literalTranslations.en: God also said: Let a firmament be made in the midst of the waters and let it divide the waters from the waters.
